roles.title: Contributor
roles.earnedBy: a landed pull request, an accepted intake issue or an answered question

roles.title: Triager
roles.earnedBy: sustained help with intake issues and questions

roles.title: Reviewer
roles.earnedBy: landed pull requests plus reviews that held up

roles.title: Maintainer
roles.access: Admin; the only role that changes repository settings

conduct.contact: GitHub's "Report content" menu on any comment, issue, discussion or pull request (choose "Report to repository admins"; it reaches the maintainers listed in GOVERNANCE.md privately)
